zh.title: 許哲誠
zh.subtitle: 全端開發／互動應用開發
zh.description: 新媒體藝術碩士，專注 Unity (C#) 客戶端架構、XR 體感互動與遊戲核心邏輯開發。具備軟體工程架構與全端開發整合實力，能無縫打通前端體驗、後端通訊與 3D 數位資產，並熟練運用 AI 工具加速產出，兼具美術視野與工程思維，能獨立高效落實各類互動系統與流暢體驗。

en.title: HSU, CHE-CHENG
en.subtitle: Fullstack Dev / Interactive App Dev
en.description: Master of New Media Arts specializing in Unity (C#) client architecture, XR physical interaction, and core game logic development. Possesses software engineering architecture and fullstack integration capabilities, seamlessly bridging frontend experience, backend communications, and 3D digital assets, proficient in AI tools to accelerate delivery, combining artistic vision with engineering rigor to independently build high-performance interactive systems.
